svg.title: esfr2024: public-reference ISO12233 reconstruction
svg.desc: Approximate public-reference reconstruction. Not certified ISO-compliant. See data/modern_profiles.json for measured and selected parameters.
svg.metadata: {"coordinate_unit": "mm", "geometry_verified_against_full_2024_standard": false, "parameters": {"background": 0.2, "border": 0.005, "dark": 0.05, "edge_start_deg": 5, "focus_radius_mm": 5, "oecf_endpoints": [0.045, 0.9], "patch_size_mm": 12.5, "registration_centers": [[120, 65], [120, 175], [220, 175]], "registration_radius_mm": 5.5, "star_centers": [[170, 120], [86.6666666667, 120], [253.3333333333, 120], [170, 45], [170, 195], [76.6666666667, 50], [263.3333333333, 50], [76.6666666667, 190], [263.3333333333, 190]], "star_side_mm": 50, "white": 0.9}, "provenance": {"documented": {"canvas_active_mm": "340x240 / 300x200, QA100 public specification page 2", "edge_reflectance": "0.20/0.05 and four-cycle 5-degree structure from indexed 2024 table C.1; 4:1 independently corroborated by IS&T and QA100", "star_side_mm": "25% of active height in indexed table C.1"}, "measured_or_inferred": {"oecf_positions": "staggered 16-patch arrangement and numbering measured from Figure 13 and QA100 preview", "registration": "three asymmetric circles measured from Figure 13", "star_centers": "2022 authors paper Figure 13; inferred 4:3 diagonal-normalized field positions reproduce preview centres"}, "selected": {"border_white": "0.005 and 0.9 synthetic reflectance endpoints", "focus": "dual-density quadratic zone plate formula and 5 mm radius selected to resemble preview; not measured focus transfer", "oecf_endpoints": "synthetic 20:1 range, QA100 product contrast; 16 log-spaced values are our choice, not claimed ISO14524 sequence"}}, "reconstruction": "public-reference reconstruction; measured layout and explicitly selected parameters", "standard_certification": false, "status": "available_public_reconstruction", "target_standard": "ISO 12233:2024"}
